patch.value: Linked-test schema sandbox breaks package prepare hooks that install the PM merge driver
GH-743: preserve source Git workspace identity or provide an explicit acceptance context when linked package gates invoke prepare hooks that run pm merge install.

linked execution provides a documented safe contract for package lifecycle hooks that require source Git identity; pm merge install succeeds in the supported acceptance context without exposing the real tracker to test mutation; collision failures classify deterministically with actionable guidance; direct and linked npm pack prepare paths have parity tests; docs explain schema/tracker/auto context selection
Git repositories whose package prepare hook runs pm merge install
Link a release gate containing npm pack --dry-run; the package prepare hook runs pm merge install while linked execution rewrites PM_PATH to an external schema sandbox.

The authoritative linked release gate preserves safe tracker isolation while package lifecycle Git integration resolves the real source repository, or an explicit context mode supports the acceptance workflow.
pm merge install resolves repository membership from the external sandbox tracker, fails as outside the Git repository, and the otherwise-passing release gate is classified as assertion_failure.
Packages adopting the required field-aware merge driver cannot record their complete release gate as authoritative linked PM evidence.
